page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server provides 64 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, resulting in 64 vCPUs. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from other tenants.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density relative to the vCPU count makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of excess compute resources. Appropriate workloads include in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing applications.
